! Game text
| Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to [[Bad Feeling Have I]]. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except [[Corellian Retort (V){{!}}Corellian Retort]]) are not stacked on [[Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V){{!}}Do They Have A Code Clearance?]]. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]  ||  Deploy on table.
